programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle in 'Hill Fu', then in 'Sun's Out, Fun's Out', It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward and Plankton put on a play in 'Who's Afraid of Mr. Snippers?', then in 'A Fish Called Sandy', Sandy experiences life as a fish. (S15, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Star's pet has puppies in '10 and 1 Toilets', and then in 'Family Plotz', the Star family spends a day at the cemetery. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with the dumbest aliens in the universe in 'In a Space Pickle', then in 'Stare Wars', Patrick and GrandPat compete for the last lick of a baking spoon. (S4, ep 9)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob takes on Sandy in a series of extreme activities in 'Pressure', and then in 'The Smoking Peanut', SpongeBob tries to hide what he did to an oyster at the zoo. (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Cecil shows Patrick his moustache collection in 'Dad's Stache Stash', and then in 'A Root Galoot', The Star family brings a mandrake root into their home. (S1, ep 22)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward is not allowed into SpongeBob and Patrick's treehouse in 'Club SpongeBob', and then in 'My Pretty Seahorse', SpongeBob adopts a sea horse, and takes it everywhere.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward swallows his clarinet and Sandy offers to shrink herself into a mini submarine to get it back in 'Squidtastic Voyage', then in 'That's No Lady', Patrick thinks he's a wanted starfish.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony in 'In Search of Camp Noodist', then in 'Kitchen Sponge', SpongeBob helps at the Krusty Kanteen. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward becomes monstrously huge, which only pleases SpongeBob and Patrick, in 'Giant Squidward', and in 'No Nose Knows', Patrick notices that he has no nose. How does he smell? He doesn't. Yet!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward bets SpongeBob that he can't go a day without crying in 'A Day Without Tears', and then in 'Summer Job', Mrs Puff has to work through her summer break at the Krusty Krab.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Squidina hires an assistant who's a little too good at his job in 'Squidina's Little Helper', then in 'I Smell a Pat', The Patrick Star Show is interrupted by a most peculiar stench. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The enemies of the Star family team up to exact their revenge in 'Best Served Cold', then in 'Tattoo Hullabaloo', Bunny's sailor tattoo finds himself in trouble. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton's computer wife Karen ends up working at the Krusty Krab after being replaced by a newer model in 'Karen 2.0', and in 'InSPONGEiac', SpongeBob can't get to sleep, and asks Patrick to help.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When SpongeBob hides the secret formula at home, Gary must protect it from Plankton in 'Pineapple Invasion', then in 'Salsa Imbecilicus', an accident causes everyone in town to become like Patrick.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab in 'Mad Science Squirrel', then in 'To Pop a Bubble', SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition in 'Painting with Squidward', then in 'Kamp Kow', The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cow with a big appetite. (S1, ep 19)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hypnotizes everyone in Bikini Bottom into becoming GrandPats in 'Mass Gramp-nosis', then in 'Cart of Darkness', Squidina leads Patrick on a grocery shopping mission. (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Patrick Show sells merchandise in 'The Patrick Show Cashes In', then in 'The Star Games', Patrick hosts a series of game shows. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton's family open a restaurant in 'Blood Is Thicker Than Grease', then in 'Don't Make Me Laugh', SpongeBob can't stop laughing. (S14, ep 4)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Krusty Krew builds a boat for their penny-pinching captain in 'Abandon Twits', and then in 'Wallhalla', SpongeBob discovers a crazed castaway living in his walls.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Star family goes on a college tour for Patrick in 'Zoo U', then in 'A Remembrance of Grand-Past', GrandPat shares his life stories to spoil every movie at the theatre. (S4, ep 7)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick learns what GrandPat's childhood was like in 'Little Patscals', and then in 'The Pre-Historic Patrick Star Show', Cave Pat hosts a show with his cave family. (S1, ep 20)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: After getting rid of Ouchie, Pinkeye takes over the Star house in 'Get Ouch', and in 'Day of the Living Dad Jokes', Patrick and Squidina must find safety amidst the dad joke apocalypse. (S3, ep 12)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick try to prove their 'Life Insurance' protects them from any danger, then in 'Burst Your Bubble', SpongeBob blows himself a bubble boat, and everyone in town wants one!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gary is given a set of limbs to keep up with SpongeBob in 'Gary's Got Legs', then in 'King Plankton', Plankton shrinks himself down and declares himself king of SpongeBob's aquarium.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: When Gary gets lost outside, he has to go on an incredible journey to get back home in 'Food Con Castaways', and then in 'Snail Mail', Spongebob accidentally fibs to his pen pal, and must keep it up!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs tries to find enough food to feed Pearl as she goes through her 'Growth Spout', and then in 'Stuck in the Wringer', after showering, SpongeBob gets stuck in his wringer.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs is messing up Pearl's preparations in 'The Slumber Party', and then in 'Grooming Gary', SpongeBob gives Gary a makeover, so that he can enter him in a pet show. But Gary's not so keen.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob must stay clean for 'Picture Day' in boating school, Patrick eats for free in 'Pat No Pay', and then in 'Blackjack', SpongeBob must stand up to his nefarious cousin Blackjack.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob is determined to have a great day in 'The Best Day Ever', and then in 'The Gift Of Gum', Patrick gives SpongeBob a gift - an enormous ball of used chewing gum. Best present ever?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mrs Puff will do anything to make sure that SpongeBob passes his driving test in 'No Free Rides', and in 'I'm Your Biggest Fanatic', SpongeBob finds out his hero isn't so great. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob can't understand why no-one wants to go near him in "Something Smells", and then in "Bossy Boots", Mr Krabs' daughter Pearl gets a job at the Krusty Krab. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick tell all sorts of fibs to sell chocolate door to door in 'Chocolate With Nuts', and then in 'Superfriends', Mermaidman and Barnacle Boy are back once more!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr Krabs is determined to uncover Plankton's next devious plot in 'Spy Buddies', we learn advanced boating techniques in 'Boat Smarts', and Mr Krabs holds a competition in 'Good Old Whatshisname'.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob is determined to find out everything there is to know about Vikings in 'Dear Vikings', and then in 'Ditchin', Patrick persuades SpongeBob to ditch class, but fun soon turns to guilt.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob can't say no to anyone, so orders a product to make things better in 'The Abrasive Side'. Then in 'Earworm', SpongeBob gets a song stuck in his head.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Patrick and Squidward must survive together in the woods in 'Squisery', and in 'Game Night', The adults sneak away to play a board game, but they have to hide from one camper in particular. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: End of Summer Daze: As everyone packs up and leaves Kamp Koral, SpongeBob and Patrick stay to catch jellyfish. But two criminals arrive to use the emptied camp as their criminal hideaway! (S2, ep 13)

programme.title: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty ...
programme.desc: ..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and the world in 'Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!', and in 'Chum Fricassee', Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton!

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One Where Estelle Dies: Joey is so upset by all of the change in his friends' lives that Phoebe goes to extreme lengths to prevent him from learning about the sudden death of his agent. (S10, E15)

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One Where Heckles Dies: After Mr. Heckles dies and leaves all his belongings to Monica and Rachel, Chandler discovers eerie similarities between Heckles and him. (S2, E03)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One With Phoebe's Husband: Phoebe reveals she married a gay Canadian ice dancer to help him get his green card. This spurs Joey and Chandler to share some of their secrets. (S2, E04)

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: The One With Five Steaks And An Eggplant: Income issues divide the friends. Monica, Ross and Chandler have money, and Phoebe, Rachel and Joey don't. (S2, E05)
